rationale.campaign_length: 结构化本地库定位54项B58直接任务，含并行美德线。
rationale.colonization: 形成前冒险团经营东坎诺可涉及拓殖，B58专属主线以既有地区征服和治理为主。
rationale.complexity: 形成条件、十项美德、骑兵设施、事件选择与宗教战争计数交错。
rationale.dark_story: 绿潮灭国、宗教压制与强制改宗带有阴影，但不是献祭或毁灭故事。
rationale.difficulty: 前段形成门槛和后段较高胜仗累计使战役偏长；强弱未实机测评。
rationale.diplomacy: 摄政王庭宗教关系、科琳派接触和坎诺政治有外交面向。
rationale.early_pressure: 先从其他国家取得塔兰顿及西卡斯塔诺十省，才能进入B58专属任务。
rationale.magic_artifice_intensity: 法师顾问和传奇武器出现，但骑士、骑兵与宗教政治明显更核心。
rationale.narrative_density: 古国覆亡、骑士美德、战马、王庭重组及坎诺宗教目标构成完整长篇。
rationale.tall_play: 塔兰顿重建、长枪学院、马场及行政设施需要本土建设，但非唯一循环。
rationale.trade_economy: 国库与产业需支持马场、建筑和传奇长枪，未确认专属贸易循环。
rationale.warfare: 复国征服、骑兵任务与后期宗教战争构成主轴，终段还有累计胜仗要求。

identity.appearance: 绿潮毁灭的古王国；1444年当前省份历史未检出B58领土，后由合格国家通过复兴决议形成
identity.formation_scope: 常规决议允许符合西卡斯塔诺、摄政王庭、东坎诺文化或冒险团、塔兰顿及其他条件的多个前身形成

predecessors.relationship: 特殊可选前身；去怪物化与隐藏忠诚条件满足后由专属事件形成B58并改显示名，不是唯一形成者

identity.region: West Castanor / Escann（西卡斯塔诺／东坎诺）

national_ideas.scope_note: 国家传统、七项国家理念与野心；不含可选理念组、种族/政府加成。多套候选与条件分别列示，不视为同时叠加；形成时是否接受新理念由实际事件/决议与玩家选择决定。

description.text: 阿德尼卡王国是「骑士」和骑士精神的诞生地。当阿德尼卡在绿潮中倒下时，那闪耀着荣誉和骑士精神的灯塔就消失了。随着阿德尼卡的再次重塑，我们将奋起实现我们祖先的理想，再次闪耀。带着正直的心，我们的骑士们将重拾昔日的荣耀，对抗不公。
description.text_en: The Kingdom of Adenica was the birthplace of the common ideals of "knights" and chivalry. When Adenica fell during the Greentide, that shining beacon of honour and chivalry was lost. With Adenica reforged again, we will rise to meet the ideals of our forefather and shine once more. With righteous hearts, our knights will reclaim their former glory as they ride against injustice.

description.text: 阿德恩是卡斯特罗斯的长子，祂是荣誉、正义和骑士之神。我们的王国建立之初和现在重建之时，我们的人民完全信奉这些理想。为此，每个男人、女人和孩子都在心中许下这样的誓言：「我们是阿德恩的长矛，是祂所代表的一切。无论我们面对什么邪恶，我们都不会动摇。」
description.text_en: Adean is the first-born son of Castellos, and the god of honour, justice and chivalry. When our kingdom was founded, and now refounded, our people embraced these ideals in their entirety. To this end, every man, woman, and child holds this pledge in their hearts: "We are the spear of Adean and all he stands for. No matter what evil we face, we shall not falter."

description.text: 毫无疑问，我们也认定科琳的飞升成神是应得的，因为她以勇敢的牺牲结束了绿潮。然而，如今试图篡夺摄政王庭的存在也许真的是阿格拉多斯重生并向诸神宣战，而不是飞升的科琳。科琳教徒效忠的并非科琳和她的信仰，而是阿格拉多斯。这种卑鄙的异端邪说和对科琳和摄政王庭的亵渎是不能容忍的。我们必须再次成为阿德恩之矛。
description.text_en: There is no doubt in our minds that Corin deserved her ascent to godhood for her valiant sacrifice ending the Greentide. Yet this attempted usurpation of the Regent Court shows that perhaps it was truly Agrados reborn, not Corin ascendant, that has declared war upon the gods. The Corinites do not pledge themselves to Corin and her beliefs, but to Agrados. This vile heresy and desecration of both Corin's name and the Regent Court as a whole cannot be tolerated. We must be the spear of Adean once more.

effects.label_zh: 通过战争强制改变宗教的花费

description.text: 卡斯塔诺沦陷后，阿德尼卡为了争霸而与其他继业者国家作战。它战斗到最后，直到绿潮毁灭了东坎诺。即使被击倒，它的精神仍在战斗。在烈火，鲜血和钢铁的洗礼下，阿德尼卡重获新生。阿德尼卡人从不害怕为正义而战，他们已经准备好并愿意再次继续战斗。
description.text_en: When Castanor fell, Adenica fought for its sovereignty against the other successor states. It fought to the last as the Greentide brought ruin to Escann. Even when struck down, its spirit continued to fight. And, through fire, blood and steel, Adenica was reforged. Adenners have never feared fighting for what was right and they are ready and willing to continue that fight once more.

description.text: 在阿德尼卡，我们为我们的高尚行为的高标准感到自豪。它是我们文化和社会的核心元素，仅次于我们的信仰。这种高度的荣誉和尊重大大降低了我们官僚机构内部的腐败、勒索和滥用权力的程度。
description.text_en: In Adenica, we pride ourselves on our high standards of honourable conduct. It is a core element of our culture and society, second only to our faith. This high level of honour and respect has led to a vastly lower level of corruption, blackmail and abuse of power within our bureaucracy.

description.text: 要统治阿德尼卡，你必须证明自己值得统治。要做到这一点，一个人必须在登上王位之前获得骑士身份。这是我们王国长期以来的传统，并被证明是非常有用的。我们的骑士王以其骑士精神和高尚的行为闻名于世，是许多统治者和继承人的榜样。这一声誉使我们在国际社会中处于良好地位。
description.text_en: To rule in Adenica, you must prove yourself worthy of rule. To do this, one must obtain knighthood before ascending to the throne. This has been a long standing tradition within our kingdom, and has proven profoundly useful. Our Knight-Kings are known throughout the world for their chivalrous and honourable conduct, and are role models to many rulers and heir-apparents. This reputation has left us in good standing within the global community.

description.text: 我们同时亲近安本纳尔帝国和重生的东坎诺诸国的，这为我们提供了一个独特的机会。我们能够借鉴西坎诺人的规则和创新，以及来自东坎诺诸国的军事专业知识。我们可以利用这一优势保持领先，并确保我们有能力保护那些有需要的人。
description.text_en: Our proximity to both the Empire of Anbennar and the reborn realms of Escann have provided us a unique opportunity. We are able to draw on the regulations and innovations of the Western Cannorians, and the military expertise from the Escanni realms. We can leverage this advantage to stay head of the curve, and ensure our ability to protect those in need.

description.text: 尽管我们的部族非常年轻，但其历史可以追溯到绿潮的早期。当兽人入侵的时候，他们从蛇脊山脉带走了他们的地精奴隶。许多地精都骑在巨型蜘蛛的背上。这些巨型蜘蛛骑手是一股可怕的力量，但它们也有一个很大的缺点。巨型蜘蛛不是东坎诺土生土长的动物，所以当地精在战斗中失去坐骑时，即使能找到替代品，代价也是极其昂贵的。狗在东坎诺并不罕见，大量的流浪狗在这片饱经战火的土地上游荡。下马的骑手们很快就开始用狗作为替代品，几乎紧接着，他们就开始饲养狗来提高速度和骑乘能力。随着绿潮的凝聚力开始崩溃，许多现在自由的狗骑士聚集在一起，组成了飞犬氏族。
description.text_en: Even though our clan is very young, its history can be traced back to the early days of the Greentide. When orcs invaded, they dragged their goblin slaves out with them from the Serpentspine. Many of these goblins came riding on the backs of giant spiders. These giant spider riders were a fearsome force; however, they had a major downside. Giant spiders are not native to Escann, so when a goblin lost their mount in battle, it was extremely expensive, if possible at all, to get a replacement. What wasn’t rare to find in Escann were dogs; plenty of stray dogs roamed the now war-ravaged land. Dismounted riders soon began using dogs as replacements, and almost immediately after that, they began breeding them to improve speed and riding capability. As the cohesion of the Greentide started to collapse, many of these now-free dog riders came together and formed the Flying Hound clan.

description.text:
我们这些地精对杜坎森来说不过是炮灰，被当作脆弱的肉盾。当我们被冒险者的火器屠杀时，兽人在第一轮射击后无意识地冲锋，碾过每一个垂死的地精，让他们痛苦地结束。

现在我们自由了，这种情况将不再出现。我们将像在洞穴的黑暗中学习的那样战斗，巧妙地躲藏起来，用毒箭攻击，伏击敌人的首领，让他们的军队流血。这就是地精的战争方式，只要我们还自由，就会永远遵循这种方式。
description.text_en:
We goblins were nothing but fodder to the Dookanson, used as flimsy meat shields. And while we were slaughtered by adventurer firearms, the orcs mindlessly charged after the first barrage, running over every dying goblin and bringing them to an agonising end.

 Now that we are free, this will no longer be. We will fight as we learned in the darkness of the caverns, cleverly hiding and attacking with poisoned arrows, ambushing enemy leaders and bleeding their armies. This is the way of goblin warfare, and it is the way we will forever follow as long as we are free.

description.text: 杜坎森之死的消息传开后，几乎所有的地精都欣喜若狂，但又对未来感到非常茫然。但叶尔格克没有。据说，当消息传到他的耳朵里时，从他炯炯有神的眼神和咧开的大嘴就能看出他看到了机会。叶尔格克立刻吹响了集结号，许多地精都站到了他的一边，尤其是在狗骑士中间，他们最终称他为飞犬氏族的头目。不幸的是，叶尔格克并没有成为我们这个时代伟大的军事家。他最终盲目地将我们推向战争，并在任何可能的地方挑起战斗，不计后果。幸运的是，我们很快就发现叶尔格克在外交方面很有一套。当被激怒的外国外交官闯进来，要求他对自己的行为做出解释时，叶尔格克总能准确地知道该说什么，以及如何把谈话引向对他有利的方向。和他聊过之后，你很难再对这样一个魅力十足的人生气，他多次成功地让部族摆脱了可能面临的最坏后果。自从他去世后，族人们一直试图采用他的外交风格。
description.text_en: When news of the Dookanson's death spread, nearly every goblin was ecstatic, but left feeling very uncertain about the future. Not Elgek, though. When word reached his ears, it is said you could just tell he saw opportunity from the look that was shining forth from his eyes and his big grin. Immediately Elgek sounded a rallying cry which amassed many goblins to his side, especially amongst dog riders who eventually dubbed him clanboss of the Flying Hound clan. Unfortunately, Elgek did not turn out to be the great military mind of our time. He ended up blindly rushing us into wars and picking fights wherever he could, damn the consequences. Luckily, we did soon learn that Elgek had a great knack for diplomacy. When enraged foreign diplomats came barging in and demanding answers for his actions, Elgek always knew exactly what to say and how to steer the conversation in his favor. It was hard to stay mad at such a charismatic personality after having a chat with him, and he managed to get the clan out of facing the worst possible consequences many times. Since his passing, the clan has tried to adopt his style of diplomacy going forward.

description.text:
虽然东坎诺仍然是一个充满敌意的地方，我们以前的俘虏和冒险者仍然潜伏在这里，但东坎诺是一个比蛇脊山脉更宜居的地方，这里有茂密的森林和宁静的湖泊。在这里，我们不需要为任何食物或水的来源而争斗，因为大家都有很多。

随着这种丰收，各氏族之间也发生了变化。在山洞的黑暗中庆祝的古老传统，现在变成了在阳光下、在献给人类众多神灵的古老废墟寺庙的阴影下举行的节日。在这个美丽的地方，我们地精可以创造出比我们古老家园更好的东西。也许我们终于找到了一个家。
description.text_en:
Though still a hostile place with our former captors and adventurers still lurking, Escann is a much more pleasant place to live than the Serpentspine, with its lush forests and serene lakes. Here, we need not fight over any source of food or water for there is plenty for all.

 With this bounty has come changes among the clans. The ancient traditions celebrated in the darkness of the caves are now festivals in the sunlight and under the shadow of ancient ruined temples consecrated to the many gods of mankind. In this beautiful place, we gblins can create something better than our ancient homeland. Perhaps we found a home at last.

description.text:
东坎诺不仅有丰富的食物和资源，而且还有知识。在古老的人类遗迹中，有书籍、卷轴和各种形式的书面材料，它们在杜坎森人带来的荒芜中幸存下来。所有这些都和其他战利品一样有价值。

然而，这些文字是用一种不同于我们勉强学会的矮人的粗俗语言写成的。如果我们要利用这些宝藏，就必须破译这种语言。幸运的是，我们地精同样狡猾而聪明。为了学习这种「通用」的文字，我们将捕获那些有能力的冒险者，强迫他们教我们人类的语言，并从那些在我们之前居住在这些美丽土地上的人留下的知识中学习。
description.text_en:
Escann is not only rich in food and resources, but also knowledge. Among the old human ruins are books, scrolls and all manner of written stuffs that survived the desolation brought by the Dookanson. All as valuable as any other loot.

 However, these texts are written in a language unlike the crude tongue of the Dwarves we came to grudgingly learn. If we are to make use of this treasure we must decipher this language. Fortunately, we goblins are equally cunning and intelligent. To learn this "common" script, we will capture those adventurers who can and force them to teach us the language of humanity, and learn from the knowledge left by those who inhabited these beautiful lands before us

description.text:
随着氏族的逐步现代化，一个新的社会阶层正在出现，由那些在氏族中被认为是最精明、最有礼貌，以及比同族人更快适应人类语言的地精所创造。他们就是纳古布。

他们包括从商人到谈判者，甚至是外交官，充当着本族与其他文明种族领域之间的纽带。他们参与每一笔交易和谈判，无论是商业还是政治，总是为氏族（和他们自己）争取最大利益。因此，这是一个拥有巨大权力的角色。在部族内部，他们获得了巨大的尊重和羡慕。
description.text_en:
With the progressive modernisation of the clans, a new social class is emerging, created by those goblins who are considered within the clan to be the most astute and have the best manners, as well as having managed to adapt more quickly to the language of humanity than their congeners. They are the Naegub.

 Ranging from merchants to negotiators and even diplomats, they act as the link between the clan and the realms of the other civilised races. They are involved in every transaction and negotiation, be they commercial or political, always wringing the most they can for the clan (and themselves). As such, it is a role of great power. Something that garners immense respect, and envy, within the clan.

description.text: 绿潮晚期，我们的民族认同感和氏族文化开始真正发展起来。狂热的浪潮席卷了我们的氏族，使骑术超越了战场，进入了普通地精的手中。坐骑不再局限于富有的地精；相反，所有人都有能力购买一只骑犬，他们也确实这么做了。骑狗比赛成了我们这片土地上最流行、最常见的运动。许多地精布商开始扩大他们的业务范围，包括为坐骑狗设计时装。在我们的领地内，无论走到哪里，都会看到地精和他的坐骑；两者密不可分！坐下来加入吧！成为飞犬氏族的地精，就是成为骑上坐犬的地精。很显然，在我们的社会中，大多数地精拒绝在没有坐骑的情况下做任何事情，大多数新兵甚至拒绝徒步上战场。
description.text_en: Towards the later years of the Greentide, our sense of identity as a people and the culture of our clan truly began to develop. A wave of fanaticism swept across our clan, which took the art of riding beyond the battlefield and into the hands of the average goblin. No longer was a mount restricted to the rich goblin; instead, all could afford to buy a riding dog, and that they did. Mounted dog races became the most popular and common sport in our lands. Many goblin clothiers began expanding their work to include fashion for dog mounts. One could not go anywhere within our domain and not see a goblin without his ride; the two were inseparable! Joined at the hip! To be a goblin of the Flying Hound clan was to be a goblin and your dog mount. This came full circle, as it was clear that most goblins within our society wouldn't do anything without a mount, and most recruits refused to even go into battle while on foot.

player_overview.avoid_if: 不想先满足形成门槛、讨厌后期累计胜仗目标或不喜欢强势单一信仰叙事的玩家。
player_overview.how_it_plays: 先在西卡斯塔诺夺地形成B58，再并行完成美德、马匹和复国任务，最后用骑士军队与王庭政治向坎诺拓展。
player_overview.overview: 阿德尼卡不是1444开局国；你要先以合格的冒险团或东坎诺国家夺回塔兰顿，再建立这个古骑士王国。形成后，长篇任务树让你培养战马、实践骑士美德、举办狩猎竞技并重组摄政王庭。你将用骑兵远征重建东坎诺，也要决定保护弱者的誓言，能否与强势的宗教统一目标共存。
player_overview.recommended_for: 喜欢骑士王国、骑兵、贵族誓言、复国与宗教政治长线的玩家。
signature_features: 骑士美德任务记录完成进度，并推动骑士贵族和尘世王庭改革。
狩猎、竞技、战马培育与传奇长枪组成持续成长的骑兵路线。
从东坎诺复国推进到阿德恩与摄政王庭的坎诺宗教政治。
player_overview.tagline: 在绿潮废墟上复兴骑士王国，让阿德恩的战马重返东坎诺。

reasons: 骑士古国复兴的明确故事
美德、誓言、狩猎与战马形成独特骑兵循环
王庭宗教政治提供长后半场
warnings: 部分后期任务有很高的累计战争门槛

positive_indicators: 骑士正义明确要求保护弱者
骑士慈善要求回馈孤儿及弱势群体
行政任务要求建立法院和市政厅以处理臣民申诉
values.rationale: 骑士正义、慈善、保护弱者及法院市政厅等公共服务提高尊严与公共利益；后期宗教目标要求压倒其他信仰政权，部分事件直接改变兽人或半兽人地区宗教，降低人格承认和克制。征服、王权、贵族制度或宗教传播本身不计善恶；具体强制程度与实机结局仍有不确定性。
red_flags: 后期任务要求坎诺不再有科琳派或揭秘派国家
针对兽人及半兽人地区的事件可直接改变宗教
复国与王庭秩序的目标可能压过异见共同体的自主性
